title: Immutable todo list
summary: Add and toggle items without mutating state or the props you were given.
prompt: Finish `TodoList`. Typing in "New todo" and clicking "Add" appends a trimmed item and clears the input; blank text is ignored. Each item is a checkbox labelled with its text, and toggling it flips `done`. Show "N left". Never mutate the `initial` array or its objects.
hints: `push` changes the array in place, so React sees the same reference and skips the update. Build a new array with `[...todos, item]`.
To toggle, map to a new array and copy the changed item: `{ ...todo, done: !todo.done }`.
